epics.title: Milestone 2: Everyday reliability
epics.body: Planned in `docs/ROADMAP.md` (milestone 2). Each ticket should leave the app releasable, with tests, and `src/engine/capabilities.ts` matching reality.

epics.title: Milestone 3: Next PhotoCraft increments
epics.body: The next image-engine steps from `docs/ROADMAP.md` (milestone 3), in the order of `docs/PHOTOCRAFT_TOOLS.md` (integration order). All engine work stays behind the boundary in `AGENTS.md` and uses only PhotoCraft APIs verified by compiling against them, on the revision in `docs/UPSTREAM.md`.

tickets.title: Recent projects and reopening the last project
tickets.body:
Roadmap milestone 2. `loadProjectFromPath` already exists in the platform layer; there is no recent-projects list yet.

## Acceptance criteria (draft)
- [ ] A recent-projects list is kept per user and shown where projects are opened
- [ ] The last project can be reopened on start; a missing file gives a clear message
- [ ] Unit tests for the list logic; Playwright flow updated
- [ ] README feature list updated

tickets.title: Relink missing files and store paths relative to the project
tickets.body:
Roadmap milestone 2. Missing assets are detected and marked today, but cannot be relinked; asset paths are absolute.

## Acceptance criteria (draft)
- [ ] A missing asset can be relinked to a new file from the library
- [ ] Paths are stored relative to the project file where possible, with a schema migration in `model/migrations.ts`
- [ ] Older project files still open (migration test)
- [ ] Users' image files are never modified

tickets.title: Autosave to a recovery file
tickets.body:
Roadmap milestone 2. No autosave or recovery exists yet.

## Acceptance criteria (draft)
- [ ] Unsaved changes are written periodically to a recovery file through the atomic write path
- [ ] After a crash, the app offers to restore the recovery file
- [ ] The recovery file never overwrites the user's project file
- [ ] Rust and unit tests cover writing and restoring

tickets.title: Duplicate layers, frames and boards; multi-select
tickets.body:
Roadmap milestone 2.

## Acceptance criteria (draft)
- [ ] Layers, frames and boards can be duplicated, each as one named undo step
- [ ] Several layers or frames can be selected and moved together
- [ ] Pure model functions with unit tests; Playwright flow for the UI

tickets.title: Asset kind editing and search in the library
tickets.body:
Roadmap milestone 2.

## Acceptance criteria (draft)
- [ ] An asset's kind can be changed in the library as an undoable edit
- [ ] The library can be searched by name
- [ ] Unit tests for the model change; keyboard and focus behaviour follow the design system

tickets.title: Review unsaved-changes and error messages with users
tickets.body:
Roadmap milestone 2: "Unsaved-changes and error messages reviewed with users." Scope and method still need to be agreed with the maintainer.

## Acceptance criteria (draft)
- [ ] Inventory of unsaved-changes prompts and `notify("error", ...)` / Rust error sentences
- [ ] Feedback from real users collected and summarised
- [ ] Messages revised where the feedback shows a problem

tickets.title: Export drawing sheets through photocraft-vector
tickets.body:
Roadmap milestone 3, integration order step 1 (export half): sheet elements are already in the model and rendered as SVG; export rasterizes them with `photocraft-vector` at an explicit DPI.

## Acceptance criteria (draft)
- [ ] Desktop app exports a drawing sheet at a chosen resolution through the engine
- [ ] Browser build shows the feature as unavailable via `capabilities.ts`
- [ ] `cargo test` covers the adapter; desktop smoke test extended
- [ ] README and `capabilities.ts` updated

tickets.title: Rectangle, ellipse and lasso masks
tickets.body:
Roadmap milestone 3, integration order step 3: selections and raster masks (rectangle, ellipse and lasso coverage, combine modes, feather, grayscale layer masks).

## Acceptance criteria (draft)
- [ ] Masks are stored in the project model and previewed and exported by the engine
- [ ] Each mask edit is one named undo step
- [ ] Model unit tests and `cargo test` for the adapter
- [ ] `capabilities.ts` and README updated

tickets.title: Brush and eraser on image layers
tickets.body:
Roadmap milestone 3, integration order step 4, after selections and masks: persist settings, samples and seed; replay for preview and export; one undo step per stroke.

## Acceptance criteria (draft)
- [ ] Strokes are persisted in the project and replayed deterministically for preview and export
- [ ] One undo step per stroke
- [ ] Users' image files are never modified
- [ ] Tests for persistence and replay; `capabilities.ts` and README updated

tickets.title: Layered PSD import
tickets.body:
Roadmap milestone 3: import the individual layers of a PSD; today only its composite image is imported.

## Acceptance criteria (draft)
- [ ] A PSD's layers become compose layers with position, opacity and visibility
- [ ] Unsupported layer types are reported, not silently dropped
- [ ] `cargo test` with a real PSD fixture; README and `capabilities.ts` updated
